appearance.title: Display
appearance.actionsLast: Tables and lists: actions at end

appearance.regionalHint: Timezone, currency, and country are normally inherited from Home Assistant. Set overrides here if HA is unavailable or the values are incorrect.

appearance.almostEmptyHint: Spools below this percentage count as almost empty (attribute almost_empty on the low-stock sensor, 1-100)
appearance.moistureWarningHint: Estimated dryness below this value = "Dry soon" (sensor moisture_spools)

bambuCloud.title: Bambu Lab Cloud
bambuCloud.hint: Connect directly to Bambu Lab Cloud via MQTT for real-time print monitoring — no Home Assistant Bambu Lab integration required.
bambuCloud.twoFaPrompt: A 6-digit verification code has been sent to your email address.
bambuCloud.noDevices: No devices found on this account.
bambuCloud.securityNote: Password stored encrypted. Connects directly to Bambu Lab — no third parties.
bambuCloud.noStatusData: No data yet — printer may not be connected via MQTT.
bambuCloud.configureInExperiments: Configure cloud source in the Cloud Config tab
bambuCloud.notConnectedHint: Not connected to Bambu Lab Cloud. Go to the Cloud Config tab to connect first.

filamentSync.title: Bambu Filament Sync
filamentSync.hint: Match and sync your FM spool inventory with the Bambu Lab filament library.
filamentSync.requiresCloud: Connect to Bambu Cloud first to enable sync.
filamentSync.modeHint_pull: Import spools from the Bambu filament library into FM.
filamentSync.modeHint_push: Push your FM inventory to the Bambu filament library.
filamentSync.modeHint_bidirectional: Match and sync in both directions.

modal.title: Sync Review
modal.alreadyLinkedDesc: {{n}} spool(s) are already linked — weight will be updated from cloud.
modal.suggestionsHint: Review suggested pairings. Pre-checked items have high confidence (≥ 80%). Uncheck to skip.
modal.newFromCloudHint: These spools exist in Bambu but not locally. Checked items will be created in FM.
modal.pushToCloudHint: These local spools have no Bambu record. Checked items will be created in Bambu.
modal.deletedFromCloudHint: These spools were removed from Bambu. Choose what to do with each local record.
modal.nothingToDo: Everything is already in sync — no actions needed.
modal.result: Done — {{matched}} linked, {{imported}} imported, {{pushed}} pushed, {{archived}} archived, {{deleted}} deleted, {{errors}} errors.
modal.resultErrors: {{n}} error(s) occurred — check the server log for details.

ha.title: Home Assistant
ha.hint: Communicates with HA internally using the Supervisor token — no manual configuration needed.

printers.title: Printers
printers.noPrintersHint: No printers configured. Add your Bambu Lab printer to enable auto print detection.
printers.name: Printer Name
printers.amsSlugHint: Leave blank if AMS uses same slug as printer
printers.energySensorHint: Cumulative kWh meter that is never reset (e.g. the total counter of a Shelly plug), not a daily or monthly counter. Read at print start and end to calculate the consumption.
printers.priceSensorHint: Sensor or helper returning the price in €/kWh. Used to calculate energy cost per print.
printers.standbyHint: Electricity consumed while the printer is idle between prints. Measured from print end to next print start.
printers.wearCostHint: Printer wear and depreciation, multiplied by the print duration and stored on the print. Empty = off.
printers.wearRecalcHint: Recalculates the wear cost of all past prints of this printer with the current rate.
printers.wearRecalcConfirm: Recalculate the wear cost of all past prints of “{{name}}” with the current rate?
printers.sensorSuggestions: {{count}} matching sensors to choose from: click the field or type. The exact entity ID is what counts.
printers.sensorNotSet: not set – energy costs will not be calculated
printers.sensorMissing: not found or not a number – energy costs will not be calculated

brandWeights.title: Brand Spool Tare Weights
brandWeights.hint: The weight of the empty plastic spool (without filament) per brand. Used to calculate remaining filament from a scale reading.
brandWeights.apply: Apply to all spools of this brand
brandWeights.applyConfirm: Set the tare of all “{{brand}}” spools to {{g}} g?

filamentCatalog.title: Filament Catalog
filamentCatalog.noEntries: No filament catalog entries yet. Click Add to create one.
filamentCatalog.importNoRows: No matching rows found — check that the CSV has columns: Brand, Material, Color Name.

dataTransfer.title: Export / Import
dataTransfer.fmDesc: Full backup and restore of all app data — spools, print history, printer configs, and settings — as a single JSON bundle.
dataTransfer.spoolsDesc: Export your spool inventory to CSV or re-import a previously exported CSV. Rows with a matching ID are updated; new rows are created for unknown IDs.
dataTransfer.bambuDesc: Fetch your recent print history directly from Bambu Lab Cloud and create matching print records in the app. Requires an active Bambu Cloud connection.
dataTransfer.bambuNotConnected: Connect to Bambu Cloud first (Settings → Experiments → Bambu Lab Cloud).
dataTransfer.experimentalDesc: Export your spool inventory in a format compatible with Spoolman. This export is experimental and the output structure may change.
dataTransfer.exportHint: Downloads a JSON bundle with all spools, prints and settings.
dataTransfer.importHint: Select a previously exported JSON file to merge data.
dataTransfer.importNote: Import is additive — existing data is never deleted. Duplicate spools will be added as new entries. Printer configs with the same device slug are skipped.
dataTransfer.importSpoolsCsvResult: CSV import done — {{created}} created, {{updated}} updated, {{skipped}} skipped
dataTransfer.exportSpoolmanHint: Downloads a Spoolman-compatible JSON with your filament types and spool inventory.
dataTransfer.importCloudResult: Imported {{imported}} of {{total}} cloud jobs ({{skipped}} already existed).
dataTransfer.importSpoolmanHint: Upload a Spoolman JSON export (from Spoolman's Export option) to import all spools into your inventory. Import is additive — existing spools are not affected.

moisture.title: Moisture estimate
moisture.formula: Dryness = 100 % − days since drying × material × storage × {{m}}. Nothing is measured. Unknown materials count {{d}}.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Group print jobs into projects for cost and material tracking
projects.name: Project name
projects.noPrints: No prints assigned yet. Click the layers icon to assign prints.
projects.deleteNote: The project will be deleted. Prints assigned to it will remain but will no longer be linked to a project.
projects.assignHint: Check prints to include in this project. Only unassigned prints and prints already in this project are shown.

moisture.title: Moisture
moisture.neverDried: Never marked as dried – no estimate
moisture.onlyMoistHint: Only spools that should be dried soon, are critical or in the dryer

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.subtitle: Maintenance log by print hours, days and filament used
maintenance.templateHint: Creates the periodic maintenance from the Bambu Lab wiki (A1): time and spool intervals, counted from now. Every task can be changed or disabled.
maintenance.templateAdded: {{n}} tasks added from the Bambu recommendations (counted from now).
maintenance.templateNothing: All Bambu recommendations are already there.
maintenance.name: Task
maintenance.limitsHint: Whatever is reached first counts. Empty = not used. 1 spool ≈ 1000 g.
maintenance.sinceHint: Print hours and grams count from the prints finished after this.
maintenance.doneConfirm: Log "{{name}}" as done? Counting starts again.
maintenance.deleteEntryNote: Deleting only removes the entry, counting stays.

labels.title: QR code & label
labels.hasLabelHint: Set automatically when printing or downloading
labels.clipped: The printhead prints at most {{mm}} mm wide, the label is adjusted when printing on the Niimbot.
labels.connectHint: Switch on the Niimbot (e.g. D110), then pick it in the Bluetooth dialog.
labels.noBluetooth: This browser has no Bluetooth (e.g. the Home Assistant app). Open the add-on in Chrome or Edge to print directly. PNG, PDF and Print work everywhere.
labels.fontSizeHint: Auto fills the label; fixed sizes give uniform labels.
labels.layoutSingleHint: Label printer, one page per label
labels.qrTargetHint: Empty = automatic (this Home Assistant address). The code opens the spool in the add-on.
labels.nothingSelected: Select filaments to see the preview.
